svg.title: Normal layers at the elliptic Tricomi boundary
svg.desc: Four exact smooth envelopes in logarithmic normal distance, followed by their common linear rescaling. These are test functions, not computed Airy solutions.
svg.text: The Tricomi layer: normal width λ⁻²ᐟ³
Exact envelopes of compact test packets; the tangential oscillation is omitted.
Nonzero where λ⁻²ᐟ³ < x < 2λ⁻²ᐟ³. The boundary x = 0 is outside the logarithmic axis.
Both −∂ₓ² and the principal term λ²x scale as λ⁴ᐟ³. See TH25 and its complete solution.
